description: Election Commission - A member of the Trincomalee Town & Gravets Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct action taken under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and relates to the composition of an elected body, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate registrations, and declarations related to holding or vacating office.
